users_has_identifier.name: users_has_identifier
users_has_identifier.value: "users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."username" IS NOT NULL

institution_profiles_colors_hex.name: institution_profiles_colors_hex
institution_profiles_colors_hex.value: ("institution_profiles"."primary_color" IS NULL OR "institution_profiles"."primary_color" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$') AND ("institution_profiles"."secondary_color" IS NULL OR "institution_profiles"."secondary_color" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')

courses_due_day.name: courses_due_day
courses_due_day.value: "courses"."due_day" IS NULL OR "courses"."due_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 28 OR "courses"."due_day" = 31

batch_memberships_dates.name: batch_memberships_dates
batch_memberships_dates.value: ("batch_memberships"."status" = 'ACTIVE') = ("batch_memberships"."ended_on" IS NULL) AND ("batch_memberships"."ended_on" IS NULL OR "batch_memberships"."ended_on" >= "batch_memberships"."started_on")

fee_charges_source.name: fee_charges_source
fee_charges_source.value:
("fee_charges"."source" = 'GENERATED' AND "fee_charges"."fee_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_charges"."generation_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_charges"."course_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_charges"."period" IS NOT NULL)
     OR ("fee_charges"."source" = 'FINE' AND "fee_charges"."fee_item_id" IS NULL AND "fee_charges"."generation_run_id" IS NULL AND "fee_charges"."period" IS NULL AND "fee_charges"."note" IS NOT NULL)

fee_charges_cancellation.name: fee_charges_cancellation
fee_charges_cancellation.value: ("fee_charges"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "fee_charges"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "fee_charges"."cancel_reason" IS NULL) OR ("fee_charges"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "fee_charges"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_charges"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

fee_payments_void.name: fee_payments_void
fee_payments_void.value: ("fee_payments"."status" = 'VALID' AND "fee_payments"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "fee_payments"."void_reason" IS NULL) OR ("fee_payments"."status" = 'VOID' AND "fee_payments"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "fee_payments"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)
